verdict.rationale: Jules exposes an API for creating custom workflows and dispatching tasks programmatically, and usage-limit tiers reference up to 300 tasks for 'agent-heavy workflows,' with community reports of handling 'large quantities of tasks' and generating multiple PRs unattended. However, there's no documented explicit bulk/batch endpoint (e.g., submit N tasks in one call, or run one task across many repos/files simultaneously) — each task appears to be created individually via API or GitHub label. Missing for 10: a dedicated batch-submission API or UI feature for operating on many items at once, and independent confirmation of true parallel bulk execution at scale.
